project_type: Vanilla HTML/CSS/JavaScript single-page application with localStorage persistence
build_system: None — static files served directly. No build step, no bundler, no package.json. Open index.html in browser or use Live Server.
test_command: Manual: open c:\MIdtermProject\anihan_market\index.html in browser and verify functionality
verification_instructions:
1. Open index.html in browser (Chrome/Edge/Firefox)
2. Test user registration and login
3. Test product browsing, search, category filter
4. Test cart operations (add, update quantity, remove)
5. Test checkout flow (order form, confirmation)
6. Test 'My Orders' viewing past orders
7. Test admin login (admin@anihan.ph / anihan2024admin)
8. Test admin CRUD: add/edit/delete products, view orders, view customers
9. Check localStorage persistence: refresh page, verify session/cart/orders persist
10. Check responsive design on mobile viewport (DevTools)
environment_constraints: No build tools. All code runs directly in browser. localStorage API used for persistence (not secure for production). btoa() used for password hashing (demo only, not production-ready).
contribution_requirements: User request is in Tagalog/Filipino. Implementation must match the original request: 'paganahin mo lahat' (make everything functional) — user side for buying products, admin side for monitoring products, agriculture-focused product catalog with images (palay, etc.), full CRUD for products.
key_patterns:
1. Modal dialogs using <dialog> element with .showModal() and .close()
2. Toast notifications via notify() function
3. Product rendering uses template literals with array.map()
4. Event delegation: grid.querySelectorAll('[data-add]').forEach(...)
5. Currency formatting: peso() helper using toLocaleString
6. View switching: toggles .hidden class on #buyerView and #adminView
7. Admin tabs: data-panel attribute switches between admin panels
8. CSS uses CSS custom properties (--green, --ink, etc.)
9. Responsive: mobile-first with @media queries at 1000px, 700px, 370px
10. No frameworks — vanilla DOM manipulation only
